name: Exp_PChannel_System
summary: This EA trades based on the PChannel_System custom indicator, opening buy positions when price breaks above the channel and sell positions when it breaks below. It uses a price channel system with configurable period and shift to generate breakout signals, with independent controls for opening and closing positions on each side.
summary_zh: 该EA基于PChannel_System自定义指标进行交易，在价格突破通道上方时开多仓，在价格跌破通道下方时开空仓。它使用可配置周期和偏移的价格通道系统生成突破信号，并可独立控制多空方向的建仓和平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该策略基于价格通道（Price Channel）突破系统，使用PChannel_System自定义指标识别通道上下轨的突破。入场条件：当指标缓冲区8的第1根K线值大于2且第0根K线值小于3时，触发做多信号；当缓冲区8的第1根K线值小于2且第0根K线值大于1时，触发做空信号。出场条件分为两种：一是通过反向信号触发平仓（如做多时出现做空信号则平多仓），二是通过固定点数的止损和止盈平仓。仓位管理采用5种资金管理模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等。策略默认使用H4周期，止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。信号仅在出现新K线时计算，避免重复交易，但缺乏对已持仓方向的检查。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy is based on a Price Channel breakout system using the PChannel_System custom indicator to identify upper and lower channel breaks. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when indicator buffer 8's bar 1 value is greater than 2 and bar 0 value is less than 3; a sell signal triggers when buffer 8's bar 1 value is less than 2 and bar 0 value is greater than 1. Exit conditions are twofold: positions close on reverse signals (e.g., a buy position closes when a sell signal appears), and fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels in points. Position sizing supports five money management modes including fixed lots, balance-based percentage, and free margin-based percentage. The default timeframe is H4 with a 1000-point stop-loss and 2000-point take-profit, yielding a 1:2 risk-reward ratio. Signals are only calculated on new bar formation to prevent duplicate trades, but the EA lacks checking for existing positions in the same direction before opening new ones.

pros: 使用新K线过滤机制避免同一K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
提供独立的多空开仓和平仓控制开关，灵活性高
支持5种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好
止损止盈比率为1:2，具备正期望值基础
使用通道突破系统逻辑清晰，趋势跟随效果在强趋势市场中较好
pros_en: New bar filter prevents duplicate trades within the same candle, reducing overtrading risk
Independent buy/sell open and close controls offer high flexibility
Five money management modes accommodate different risk appetites
1:2 stop-loss to take-profit ratio provides a foundation for positive expectancy
Channel breakout logic is clear and performs well in strong trending markets
cons: 没有检查是否已存在同方向持仓，可能在同一趋势中重复开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点数值偏大，在波动性较低的市场中可能不适配
未设置点差过滤，在点差较大时可能不利入场
依赖自定义指标PChannel_System，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号质量
没有移动止损或追踪止损功能，无法锁定浮动利润
cons_en: No check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to duplicate entries in the same trend
Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit low-volatility markets
No spread filter, which can lead to unfavorable entries during high-spread conditions
Depends on the custom PChannel_System indicator whose logic is opaque and hard to verify
No trailing stop functionality to lock in floating profits as the trend progresses
improvements: 增加同方向持仓检查逻辑，避免重复开仓导致仓位过重
增加点差过滤和移动止损功能，提升入场质量和利润保护能力
improvements_en: Add same-direction position check to prevent duplicate entries and over-concentration of risk
Add spread filter and trailing stop functionality to improve entry quality and profit protection

risk_points: 缺乏同方向持仓检查可能导致重复建仓，风险敞口不可控
固定止损止盈点数不适应不同市场波动性，可能在低波动市场中止损过宽
risk_points_en: Lack of same-direction position check may lead to duplicate entries with uncontrolled risk exposure
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points don't adapt to varying market volatility, potentially too wide in low-volatility conditions
